system_configurations.name: RCCL-MI350P-PCIe-8GPU-Perf
system_configurations.description: Single-node 8x MI350P PCIe performance from the same Debug build as the func plan, so a preceding func run can be reused with --no-build. Compare later Debug runs on this host from the uploaded log; this file does not hard-code a bandwidth golden. The workflow does not pass --emit-results. AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter use the same -n 20 -w 5 sample. Tree+Simple AllReduce is omitted because the single-node gfx950 tuner will not select it.
